decisions.decision: Answer Adi's 2026-10-11 note on T-334 in plain words and keep it as his one input task. The exact blocker: the purge only happens if GitHub Support staff receive a request from the repo owner's signed-in adisuja account. The Orchestrator's hard rules (workshop-plan/tasks/orchestrator.py lines 74-75) forbid Claude 'messaging real people outside the team' and 'logging in as Adi', and a board note cannot widen them. Say why there is no self-serve route: deleting and recreating the repo would make Nelbin's fork the network root while it still holds 5b9f57d6. Do not attempt the send or that route. T-362 is a dropped duplicate; leave it dropped. On Adi's confirmation, log the date on T-145 and run the weekly SHA check.
